name: claude-code-specialists
description: The Claude Specialists system by Dave (DaveKJohn): a team of specialized Claudes under one Chief of Staff. Every plugin here is either a TEAM — who the specialists are — or a WORKFLOW — how work moves through the repo they land in. Teams stack: enable the core team plus whichever add-on teams fit the repo. Workflows do not: exactly one may be enabled, because two would answer the same question differently. One product, one repository, one marketplace.

plugins.name: team-alpha
plugins.description: The core team — the shared, repo-neutral specialists who work the same way in every repo. Every consuming repo enables this. Governance (CLAUDE.md + the repo lenses) stays at repo level.

plugins.name: team-lifehub
plugins.description: Add-on team for life-hub-style repos (a personal information hub / brain-based knowledge repo): Astrid, Fiona, Hugo, Ian, Onyx. Only a life-hub-style repo enables this.

plugins.name: team-shopify
plugins.description: Add-on team for Shopify store repos (e.g. smartwatchbanden): Liam, Sandra, Steven, plus the domain skill start-task. Only a Shopify repo enables this.

plugins.name: team-ecomm
plugins.description: Add-on team for commercial webshop repos (any platform): Sergio (SEO), Craig (CRO), Sean (performance/SEA), with room to grow into the wider e-commerce craft (lifecycle/email, analytics). Complementary to a platform team like team-shopify — a commercial webshop repo can enable both. Teams stack.

plugins.name: workflow-default
plugins.description: The workflow a repo gets when it has not chosen one: the specialists follow the conventions the repo already has, and name the questions it does not answer instead of filling them in. Ships the discover-workflow skill. Enable exactly one workflow -- this is the one to keep until a repo deliberately picks another.

plugins.name: workflow-davekjohn
plugins.description: DaveKJohn's own way of working, packaged as an opt-in: the branch-and-entry model, the tier ladder, the fold, the release cut, and the gates that hold them, as skills plus their shared scripts. A workflow is not a team but a method, and the name says whose it is — a consuming repo has its own way of working, and the specialists adapt to it. Enable this only if you want THIS one. Requires team-alpha, and exactly one workflow may be enabled at a time.
